compute_box_det_ap_recall: compute average precision and recall for 3D object detection across multiple scenes and IoU thresholds
eval_bboxes_and_print: evaluate 3D bounding box detections and print an ASCII table of AP and recall metrics per class
get_det_assignments_to_gt: assign predicted 3D bounding boxes to ground truth boxes based on IoU thresholds and confidence scores
compute_ap_recall: compute average precision and recall from true positive/false positive boolean matrices and detection scores
average_precision: calculate average precision from recall and precision arrays using area or 11-point interpolation mode
